response.query: How should we report and visualize effect sizes, confidence intervals, exact p-values, and multiple-comparison corrections to clearly convey uncertainty to clinicians and the public?
response.answer: Report effect sizes with confidence intervals, exact p-values, and use multiple-comparison corrections to convey uncertainty clearly. Use simple graphs like bar charts or forest plots for visualization.

results.title: The impact of digital activities on children's lives: How's Life ...
results.content: Preschoolers around 5 years old with more than 1 hour of screen time daily showed greater vulnerability in areas such as cognitive, communicative, social, physical, and emotional development compared to those with less than 1 hour of screen time [(Massaroni et al., 2023[72])](/en/publications/how-s-life-for-children-in-the-digital-age_0854b900-en/full-report/the-impact-of-digital-activities-on-children-s-lives_4df70664.html#Mendeley_hWXu__mLSlzKGzE8FQgyM2w_d046e65bd3). [(2022[88])](/en/publications/how-s-life-for-children-in-the-digital-age_0854b900-en/full-report/the-impact-of-digital-activities-on-children-s-lives_4df70664.html#CrossRef_gikSE8pNMu7W6rqifljfNg_d046e65bd3) indicates that most studies found that exceeding daily screen time recommendation to limit school-age children to no more than two hours of daily television and video game use combined is linked to higher rates of attention problems in children. [(2014[211])](/en/publications/how-s-life-for-children-in-the-digital-age_0854b900-en/full-report/the-impact-of-digital-activities-on-children-s-lives_4df70664.html#Mendeley_HlyY5YD6hD2fY5j1HHzoZA_d046e65bd3) found that for children aged 4-8, daily technology use was broadly associated with attention problems, while for pre-adolescents (9-12), only video games and technological toys were linked to such issues. The research identifies problematic screen use as patterns of behaviour that include excessive or compulsive engagement, interference with daily functioning, and the experience of associated negative consequences like reduced physical activity or social detachment [(Nagata et al., 2022[174])](/en/publications/how-s-life-for-children-in-the-digital-age_0854b900-en/full-report/the-impact-of-digital-activities-on-children-s-lives_4df70664.html#Mendeley__cdpn1Scoza5aPST8dG27w_d046e65bd3).
